t: ff.125 USA: the fall of an empire
st: Who will replace America? China or the Internet?

sec.p: Three years ago we talked about the vision of Ray Dalio, founder of Bridgewater and the 88th richest person in the world, on the possible arrival of a new world order (📈 ff.14.2 Nostradamus: Ray Dalio and the world order).
Money printing, in short, and the well-known inflation. Back then, 25 hours of work bought you one S&P 500 share; today it takes 24 days of work.

sec.t: ff.125.3 China: the next world empire?
sec.p: If the American empire is giving way, who will pick up the baton? In the physical world, China looks like the most credible candidate.

sec.t: ff.125.4 The alternative to China: the Internet
sec.p: What do you do as soon as you wake up? Check your phone or admire the national flag?
